strings.zh: 能看能摸的{NEWLINE}阿鲁夫遗迹观光！{SCROLL}请一定摸摸{NEWLINE}能推动的石板！

strings.zh: 上次我去阿鲁夫研究所时,{NEWLINE}那里的专家给我讲了{CLEAR}好多有趣的精灵传说,{CLEAR}如果你也对口袋妖怪传说感兴趣,{CLEAR}一定要去阿鲁夫研究所看看！
strings.en: The last time I went to the{NEWLINE}Ruins of Alph Research Center,{CLEAR}the experts there told me lots{CLEAR}of interesting Pokémon legends.{SCROLL}If you’re into Pokémon{NEWLINE}legends too, you’ve got to{CLEAR}visit the Research Center!
